m.def: attended by members of both sexes
choose or elect as a fellow member or colleague
ex: The church members co-opted individuals from similar backgrounds to replenish the congregation

m.def: neutralize or win over through assimilation into an established group
ex: We co-opted the independent minority tribes by pulling them into the Northern Alliance
The army tried to co-opt peasants into civil defence groups

m.def: take or assume for one's own use
ex: He co-opted the criticism and embraced it

m.def: the selection of a new member (usually by a vote of the existing membership)
the act of appointing summarily (with or without the appointee's consent)
feature as the co-star in a performance
be the co-star in a performance
